certified_statement: Let B(lambda) = F(1,lambda) = d/dr E_lambda(r)|_{r=1}. Then B(103/50) > 0, B(207/100) < 0, B(206538/100000) > 0, B(206539/100000) < 0, and B'(lambda) < 0 for every lambda in [206538/100000, 206539/100000]. Hence B has a root in (206538/100000, 206539/100000), it is the unique root in that interval, and lambda_partial < 206539/100000 strictly. The item-0 finite-box ceiling 206539/100000 is therefore a strict rational upper bound for the boundary-entry parameter, not the parameter itself.

form.coordinates: contact-centred: t = sin(chi/2), psi local azimuth about e_1
form.integral: B(lambda) = int_0^{pi/2} int_0^1 (4t/pi) [ -u h(x) - (lambda/sqrt(W)) h'(x) t(1-t^2) J / A^{3/2} ] dt dpsi
form.endpoint_behaviour: integrand vanishes at t=0 (factor 4t) and at t=1 (x=1, h(1)=0, 1-t^2=0); no corner cap required
form.measure_cross_check: (4t/pi) m h(x) = (8 t^3/pi) h(x), the kernel weight of the item-5 boundary_energy routine

conclusion.uniqueness: unique root on that interval, by B' < 0

methods.psi_partition: four exact bands of [0, pi/2], each enclosed independently
methods.t_integration: Arb rigorous adaptive integration on [0,1], inner
methods.Bprime: explicit forward differentiation in lambda, no finite differences

scope: This certificate covers the boundary-entry parameter only. It makes no claim about the uniqueness of the interior stationary branch (item 2 proper), which requires the single sign change of F_r.
